pdb_path.description: Absolute path to the input PDB (or mmCIF) structure file that `mkdssp` will analyze for secondary structure assignment.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream structure-producing tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `pdb_path` when `pdb_path` is omitted.

format.description: DSSP output format. `json` (default) returns a structured JSON suitable for downstream parsing; `dssp` returns the classic DSSP text format; `mmcif` returns DSSP-annotated mmCIF.
